objects.name: Multinational Division HQ Staff
objects.description: Full J1–J9 directorate staff from all five participating nations. The primary exercise audience covers all HQ functions including operations, intelligence, logistics, plans, fires, CIMIC, and communications.

objects.name: J3 Operations Branch
objects.description: Operations branch staff with specific focus on battle rhythm, decision cycle, and joint fires integration.

objects.name: J2 Intelligence Branch
objects.description: Intelligence staff exercising INTSUM production, ISR coordination, and intelligence support to operations.

objects.name: J4 Logistics Branch
objects.description: Logistics staff exercising sustainment planning, supply chain management, and logistics synchronisation.

objects.name: J6 Communications
objects.description: Signal and communications staff exercising C2 continuity and PACE plan execution under cyber-degraded conditions.
